# The conversion keywords are case particles glued to the source word, を for
# the accusative and から for the ablative, and neither takes a space.

# No number agreement anywhere, so 1 and 2 and a half take the same ヘルツ, and
# one hertz is sixty beats a minute rather than one.
# A minute per beat is one beat a minute. The reciprocal lands on 1 exactly when
# the period is the unit tempo is already counted in.
# No space between the number and the unit, on input or output. The separators
